answer_literals: Memory over summaries, attention over detail
selected.source_context:
content ("what am I working on now") gives the selector a signal that actually varies.
- **Metadata guards over lexical cosine.** The §8 summaries carry structured meta — open questions, failing tests. Never evict a branch whose meta says its work is unfinished. That single rule would have prevented the iter6 failure (the dedent module's branch was evicted while unsolved).
- **Move selection from Zone B to Zone C.** Summaries are cheap (~100s of tokens) and load-bearing — keep all of them, always. Detail is expensive — let DSA decide *which branch gets expanded*, not which summaries survive. "Memory over summaries, attention over detail" preserves the floor property permanently.
- **Sticky/phase-boundary membership** so any change lands where Zone B invalidates anyway (a new summary arriving).
- Embeddings behind the same cosine interface remain the paraphrase-robustness upgrade, but they're fourth on this list — the failures observed were signal-shape problems, not vocabulary problems.
